'''A human''' lived on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who had a brother named [[Donal (Nal Hutta)|Donal]]. The man lived on a [[Donal's brother's farm|farm]] with his family near the town of [[Jiguuna]], but when he was unable to pay protection money to the [[Fa'athra gang]], the criminals killed the man and his family and took over the farm.<ref name="Protection" />
